Post-Registration Journey

  1. Home
  2. Registering a Company
  3. Post-Registration Journey

Post-Registration Journey

Once your firm is registered you will be provided with dedicated support to ensure a smooth onboarding process. A typical client journey post registration will look like the illustration below

How to Get Started?

Today

Must be completed immediately

Step 01

Ensure access to the QFC Client Portal

Step 02

Start your onboarding journey on QFC Client Portal

Step 03

Get in touch with your assigned Client Relationship Manager

Step 04
Apply for Your Establishment Card

Apply for the Establishment Card (also known as the Computer Card) to obtain a Residence Permit/ QID if you are not a resident of Qatar.

Download Guid
Step 05
Complete Tax Registration & Set Your Start Date

Complete Tax Registration and determine your firm's commencement (start) date of operations.

Within 3 Months

Early compliance steps

Step 06
Complete the Registration with the Employment Standards Office (ESO)

Complete your company’s registration under the Legislation and Compliance tab in the portal and

Read More
Step 07
Submit SEF Documents to Monitoring Department

The Senior Executive Function (SEF) of the firm must provide a copy of their Residence Permit/QID

Read More
Step 08
Provide Professional Indemnity Insurance Coverage

The Senior Executive Function (SEF) of the firm must provide a copy of their Residence Permit/QID

Read More
Step 09
Appoint a QFC-Approved Auditor

Appoint a QFC-approved auditor from the Public Register within 120 days of incorporation.

Within 6 Months

Ongoing obligations

Step 10
Submit Your Annual Return on the Client Portal

Submit the Annual Return on the Client Portal after one calendar year. (This is different from the Tax Re..)

Read More
Step 11
Submit Your UBO Annual Report

Submit the UBO Annual Report after one calendar year unless there has been no change in shareholding.

Read More
Step 12
Submit the Audited Financial Statement

Submit the Audited Financial Statement on the Client Portal within four months after the financial

Read More
Step 13
Submit the Tax Return and Settle Dues

Submit the Tax Return and pay any due tax within six months after the financial year-end (typically 31st December).

Read More
Step 14
Submit the Employees List to the ESO

Submit an updated employees list the Legislation and Compliance tab in the portal by January and July of each year.

Read More
